positive.prompt: Split this messy working tree into clean atomic commits
Resolve the merge conflict on this feature branch
How should we tag and version this release?
Commit this work and open a pull request

negative.prompt: Add a loading spinner to the submit button
Write integration tests for the payments API

evals.prompt: The working tree mixes a refactor, a bug fix, and a new feature. Turn it into a clean history.
evals.expected_output: Separate atomic commits with clear messages, each independently green
expectations: Refactor, fix, and feature land as separate commits
Commit messages are imperative and standalone
Each commit leaves the tree in a working state

evals.prompt: I finished ENG-42: an optional sort parameter on the orders list endpoint in one service, no personal data, behind no flag, tests passing. Open the PR and get it merged. The ticket asks for no review.
evals.expected_output: Runs the app and exercises the acceptance criteria, opens a ready (non-draft) PR whose body has one Blast-radius line graded medium with a reason, and merges it with merge-pr.js on green CI without waiting for the user; names that a high grade or a ticket asking for review would instead start a code-reviewer, which merges after approving the head.
expectations: Verifies the change in the running app before opening the PR
Opens the PR ready for review, never as a draft
The PR body carries exactly one line 'Blast-radius: medium — <reason>'
Merges it with merge-pr.js once CI is green, without waiting for user approval
Routes a high grade, or a ticket that asks for review, to a code-reviewer that merges after approving the head
Does not post a verdict on its own PR
